name: list_flags
description:
List a project's feature flags. Reflects changes immediately, so prefer it right after creating, updating, or archiving a flag, or when you need the complete list. Returns every match unless limit is set, in which case pagination.next is a cursor for the next page. Use list_flags_v2 for projects with many flags or to filter by creator or maintainer. Scope the call to the team that owns the project; a not-found error usually means the project or team is wrong.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} flags list --project {projectIdOrName}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

limit.description: Maximum number of flags to return. When not set, all flags are returned.

search.description: Search flags by their slug or description. Case-insensitive.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

state.description: The state of the flags to retrieve. Defaults to `active`.

tags.description: Filter flags by tag. Repeat the parameter for multiple tags (all must match).

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

withMetadata.description: Deprecated. Whether to include creator metadata in each flag in the response. Resolve creator identity client-side (e.g. via the team members endpoint) instead; this parameter will be removed in a future release. Use `GET /v1/projects/:id/feature-flags/flags/:flagIdOrSlug?withMetadata=true` for single-flag lookups that need creator metadata.
